source.caption: Architecture of inception-ResNetV2 model with integrated attention mechanisms. The architecture of the optimal base model, Inception-ResNetV2, is illustrated. In this model, attention mechanisms were integrated following the first Inception-ResNet-A module, as well as after the Reduction-A and Reduction-B modules. The final model output is generated using a sigmoid activation function, producing the predicted results.
